title: Rush Fee by Parcel Contents — PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
**Rate rule.** The rush fee for today's shipment under the PAP Supply Replenishment Program is:

| Today's shipment | Rush fee |
|---|---|
| cushions or filters only, holding six units or fewer | 12.95 |
| cushions or filters only, holding more than six units | 13.95 |
| holding any other item, or no item line | no parcel rate under this rule |

## Terms

- **Today's shipment:** the enrollment's item lines with today's ship date.
- **Cushions or filters only:** every item line of today's shipment is a full face mask cushion (A7031), a nasal mask cushion (A7032), a nasal pillows pair (A7033), a disposable filter (A7038) or a non-disposable filter (A7039).
- **Units:** the units on all of today's item lines, added together.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Four nasal cushions and two disposable filters: cushions or filters only, 6 units, 12.95.
- Four nasal cushions and three disposable filters: 7 units, 13.95.
- Two nasal cushions and one headgear: holds another item, no parcel rate under this rule.
